optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services
professionalSummary: Seasoned analytics engineer with two years of experience building and maintaining telemetry‑work‑order pipelines in an industrial equipment maintenance context. Demonstrated expertise in feature engineering for failure prediction, schema coordination, and data lineage documentation. Proven ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver reliable data assets that support proactive maintenance planning.
experienceHighlights: Built an hourly Spark pipeline on Databricks that joins vibration and temperature telemetry with work‑order history, handling late‑arrival telemetry uploads. Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) and versioned changes with detailed notes on affected machine families. Coordinated schema and feature changes with planning and platform teams during fortnightly data reviews, ensuring approvals from both leads. Authored comprehensive lineage notes for the telemetry‑work‑order join, documenting source tables, late‑arrival rules, and known limitations such as missing telemetry gateways. Managed end‑to‑end responsibilities for pipeline development, feature maintenance, data‑review coordination, and lineage documentation over approximately two years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Feature‑set change log for one quarter and lineage note for the telemetry‑work‑order join, including Databricks job identifiers as verification trail (source: src_5f82770fdf55).
skills: Apache Spark, Databricks, SQL, Python, Data Pipeline Development, Feature Engineering, Data Lineage, Schema Management, Cross‑Functional Collaboration
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in building telemetry‑work‑order pipelines, maintaining failure‑prediction features, coordinating schema changes, and documenting lineage. They do not provide direct evidence of a measurable increase in early failure detection attributable solely to the candidate, nor do they confirm the candidate’s ownership of the baseline improvement.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess the candidate’s impact on early failure detection and to verify attribution of baseline improvements.

role.roleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

evidence.text: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.
evidence.notes: Directly describes pipeline construction and integration.

evidence.text: Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

Candidate said the planning team told him the model 'now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half'; he said the numbers were the planning team's, that he had not seen the evaluation, and that several other changes were made to the model in the same period.
evidence.notes: Mentions improvement but no attribution or measurement.

missingEvidence: Direct measurement of early failure capture rate attributable to the candidate’s work; documentation of baseline and post‑implementation metrics.

evidence.text: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.

supportedClaims.claim: Built an hourly Spark pipeline that joins telemetry with work‑order history and handles late arrivals.
supportedClaims.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

supportedClaims.claim: Maintained the failure‑prediction feature set and versioned changes with notes on affected machine families.
supportedClaims.witness: Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

supportedClaims.claim: Coordinated schema and feature changes with planning and platform teams, receiving approvals from both leads.
supportedClaims.witness: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

supportedClaims.claim: Documented data lineage for the telemetry‑work‑order join, including source tables, late‑arrival rule, and known limitations.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.

unsupportedClaims.claim: The candidate directly caused a measurable increase in early failure detection from 50% to 66% in the planning team's model.
unsupportedClaims.reason: No evidence attributing the improvement solely to the candidate; the candidate acknowledges other model changes and lack of personal evaluation data.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide independent evaluation metrics showing the candidate’s pipeline or feature changes led to the observed increase, with baseline and post‑baseline comparisons.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: Lack of documented, independent measurement of early failure capture rate attributable to the candidate’s work.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Candidate claims the model now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half, but admits not having seen the evaluation and that other changes were made.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify independent metrics and clarify the candidate’s specific contributions to the improvement.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide the baseline and post‑implementation metrics for early failure detection, and explain how your pipeline or feature changes contributed to any observed improvement?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Independent measurement of early failure capture rate and attribution to candidate’s work.

humanReviewChecklist: Confirm that the candidate’s pipeline and feature maintenance directly contributed to the reported improvement in early failure detection. Verify that the candidate has documented independent metrics or received confirmation from the planning team. Ensure that the candidate’s responsibilities align with all other requirements.
